verdict_msg: HARD_FAIL_(a)_BROKEN_BASE | Stage0 FAILED on REAL WORDS: CA3 next-word acc=0.2736 does NOT beat in-domain unigram=0.268 by >=0.02 (all-tokens lift=0.0056, unk_rate=0.268, vocab_cap=2000). MECHANISTIC REASON: the all-tokens floor is inflated by UNK (most-frequent token); the CLEAN in-vocab lift=-0.0397 is NEGATIVE -- the glass-box CA3 bind+cleanup predicts KNOWN next-words WORSE than their unigram frequency (robust across N_DIM 1024/4096 and window 1/10 per pre-flight; same class as the ca3 text8 HARD_FAIL). Even the real lexical stream gives the base no predictive edge over frequency -> a strong honest signal; Stage1 not run. (novel-lexeme held-out confirmed disjoint). glass-box-non-gradient confirmed.
